name: _id
description: The execution result header hash.

name: accumulatedFees
description: The accumulated fees that were payed in the execution result.

name: developerFees
description: The developer fees that were accumulated in the execution result.

name: epoch
description: The epoch when the execution result was produced.

name: gasPenalized
description: The total gas penalized in the execution result.

name: gasProvided
description: The total gas provided in the execution result.

name: gasRefunded
description: The total gas refunded in the execution result.

name: gasUsed
description: The total gas used in the execution result.

name: maxGasLimit
description: The maximum gas limit allowed for the execution result.

name: miniBlocksDetails

fields.name: firstProcessedTx
fields.description: The index of the first transaction that was processed in the miniblock.

fields.name: lastProcessedTx
fields.description: The index of the last transaction that was processed in the miniblock.

fields.name: procType
fields.description: The processing type of the miniblock.

fields.name: txsHashes
fields.description: The hashes of the transactions that were included in the miniblock.

description: An array of structures with information about the miniblocks within the execution result.

name: miniBlocksHashes
description: An array of the miniblock hashes (hexadecimal encoded) that were included in the execution result.

name: nonce
description: The sequence number of the execution result header.

name: notarizedInBlockHash
description: The hash of the block in which the execution result was notarized.

name: rootHash
description: The state root hash after applying the execution result.

name: round
description: The round when the execution result was produced.

name: shardId
description: The shard this execution result belongs to.

name: timestamp
description: The timestamp when the execution result was produced. Derived from `timestampMs`, which is the only timestamp provided by the indexer for this index.

name: timestampMs
description: The timestamp when the execution result was produced, in milliseconds.

name: txCount
description: The number of transactions that were executed in the execution result.

name: uuid
description: Unique identifier used for ES queries.
